quarterly_data.quarter: Kokusai Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026) revenue JPY 235,079 million (98.4% of the prior year, down 1.6%): product sales JPY 139,950 million (85.2%) and service sales JPY 95,129 million (127.4%). Management states NAND equipment sales and upgrade modifications mainly for DRAM grew, while China DRAM investment, active in the prior year, settled down. Operating profit was JPY 41,836 million (down 18.5%; operating margin 17.8%) on lower factory utilization, product mix and up-front R&D; adjusted operating profit JPY 47,596 million and adjusted profit JPY 34,095 million. Contract liabilities rose JPY 12.4 billion, mainly on advances received for modification projects.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kokusai Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capital expenditure JPY 16,862 million, mainly construction of the new US demo center (an R&D site) and R&D machinery. Planned new facilities (self-funded): Toyama site development and evaluation equipment for batch deposition and single-wafer plasma treatment systems, JPY 9,817 million (JPY 5,161 million paid), November 2023 to March 2027; land at the Tonami site, JPY 1,000 million, February 2026 to September 2026 (handover expected by around September 2026 after city council approval; use not yet decided, expected to support production, R&D and other steps for market growth); Kokusai Semiconductor Equipment Corporation in Oregon, US, development and evaluation equipment, JPY 18,702 million including land (JPY 5,765 million paid), November 2024 to December 2026. The company has already expanded the demo evaluation area at its Korea production site and set up the Yokohama Technology Center.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kokusai Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 18,258 million. Themes: component technology for current products, deposition for next-generation batch deposition systems (large-batch furnaces for higher productivity, mini-batch furnaces for more precisely controlled films), treatment (film-quality improvement) technology for next-generation single-wafer systems, technology and new products two generations ahead, and back-end technology (chip and wafer stacking, panel processes) at the Yokohama Technology Center. The company states that in batch systems for insulating films and metal processes it achieved further film-quality and productivity gains that helped maintain and expand PORs, mainly for memory devices, and that next-generation platform development is progressing for market rollout from next fiscal year onward. Evaluation tools are also lent to customers for device development.

quarterly_data.quarter: Kokusai Electric annual securities report: FY2026 (06-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products and strategy: the company states its batch deposition systems (AdvancedAce and TSURUGI series; large batch up to 200 wafers, mini batch up to 100) ranked first in 2025 revenue share in the batch ALD-compatible tools market (TechInsights), and its MARORA single-wafer plasma treatment system ranked first in 2025 revenue share in the Plasma Gate Modification Tools market (Gartner); it plans to grow plasma treatment as its next pillar after batch deposition. It is extending batch ALD and plasma treatment technology built in NAND to Logic/Foundry and DRAM and strengthening advanced packaging work. In legacy 200mm equipment, sales for power devices including SiC are increasing. The mid-term plan, revised in May 2026, targets revenue of JPY 330 billion or more and an adjusted operating margin of 30% or more by the fiscal year ending March 2029.
quarterly_data.figure: mid-term target revenue JPY 330 billion+ and adjusted OP margin 30%+ by FY March 2029
